lemmas.name: regret_decomposition
lemmas.statement: E[R_n] = sum_i Delta_i E[T_i(n)] (counting identity + linearity)

lemmas.name: threshold_split
lemmas.statement: T_i(n) <= l + sum_t 1{arm i played at t and T_i(t-1) >= l} (counting: pulls beyond the l-th require selection)

lemmas.name: index_condition
lemmas.statement: arm i played at t only if UCB index of i at its count s with bonus sqrt(2 ln t / s) >= optimal arm's index (selection rule, definitional)

lemmas.name: bad_events_contradiction
lemmas.statement: if neither underestimate nor overestimate and s >= ceil(4 ln n / Delta_i^2) then contradiction via 2 sqrt(2 ln t / s) <= Delta_i — REFUTED: needs s >= 8 ln t / Delta_i^2 (library ucb_index_three_way_split's third disjunct is n < 8L/gap^2)

lemmas.name: hoeffding_fixed_pair
lemmas.statement: P(mean of first s iid [0,1] samples deviates by sqrt(2 ln t/s)) <= t^-4 at FIXED (t,s); union over s handled by summation (valid)

lemmas.name: tail_sum
lemmas.statement: sum_t sum_s sum_s* 2 t^-4 <= sum_t 2 t^-2 = pi^2/3 (p-series)

lemmas.name: count_bound
lemmas.statement: E[T_i(n)] <= 4 ln n/Delta_i^2 + 1 + pi^2/3 — BLOCKED downstream of bad_events_contradiction

lemmas.name: regret_assembly
lemmas.statement: R_n <= sum_i (4 ln n/Delta_i + c Delta_i) — BLOCKED downstream

falsifications.claim: s >= 4 ln n/Delta^2  =>  2 sqrt(2 ln t/s) <= Delta  (squares: 8L/s <= Delta^2)

certificate.check: s=16 >= 4L/Delta^2=16 holds; 8L/s = 1/2 > 1/4 = Delta^2 (exact in Q); correct threshold is 8L/Delta^2

falsifications.reason: definitional property of the argmax selection rule — no standalone numeric content to sample

verdict_reason: bad_events_contradiction (Step 4 at Step 2's threshold) is false: s >= 4 ln n/Delta^2 does not give 2 sqrt(2 ln t/s) <= Delta; exact counterexample L=1, Delta=1/2, s=16 (8L/s = 1/2 > 1/4 = Delta^2). The kernel-checked library lemma ucb_index_three_way_split needs n < 8L/gap^2 as its third disjunct — the correct threshold is 8 ln n/Delta^2, so the theorem's constant 4 should be 8. Step 4's own text says 'l >= 8 ln n/Delta^2', contradicting Step 2's definition l = ceil(4 ln n/Delta^2)

refutations.description: s >= ceil(4 ln n / Delta^2) implies 2 sqrt(2 ln t/s) <= Delta (Step 4's contradiction step at the Step 2 threshold); counterexample L=1, Delta=1/2, s=16
refutations.code:
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- Counterexample to the mutated Step 4 inference: at L = ln n = 1,
Δ = 1/2, the proof's own threshold s = ⌈4L/Δ²⌉ = 16 satisfies the
hypothesis s ≥ 4L/Δ², yet the required conclusion 8L/s ≤ Δ²
(the squares form of 2√(2L/s) ≤ Δ) is false: 1/2 > 1/4. -/
theorem mutated_threshold_counterexample :
    (16 : ℚ) ≥ 4 * 1 / (1/2)^2 ∧ ¬ (8 * 1 / 16 ≤ ((1:ℚ)/2)^2) := by
  constructor <;> norm_num

suspects.suspicion: threshold l = ceil(4 ln n / Delta^2) but the contradiction in Step 4 requires s >= 8 ln n / Delta^2; factor 2 too small, theorem constant 4 unsupported
asserts 'l >= 8 ln n/Delta^2' contradicting Step 2's l = ceil(4 ln n/Delta^2); with s >= 4 ln t/Delta^2 one only gets 2 sqrt(2 ln t/s) <= sqrt(2) Delta > Delta
fixed-(t,s) Hoeffding sound but validity rests on the union bound over s in Step 6
